scope: Conditional execution segment proofs in two prefix windows; complete CSLib admission, execution and aggregation are not proved by these measurements.
benchmark_method: Generate the native sample, compile once, and share the immutable setup among scoped workers with independent Rayon pools. Every sample runs the production witness builder, prover and verifier. Worker wall includes pool creation, all proof checks and create-new file writes when requested; loading, native replay and setup are timed separately. Samples include startup effects and do not establish steady-state or full-workload rates.

failed_trial.name: parallel-16
failed_trial.reason: A 64 MiB allocation failed at the virtual address limit; this was not a proof rejection.
failed_trial.gnu_time_footer_caveat: GNU time prints Exit status 0 after reporting signal 6; the SSH command actually returned 134.
failed_trial.retry: New output directory, 768 GiB virtual address limit, user systemd scope enforcing 400 GiB MemoryMax and zero swap; all 64 proofs verified.

fresh_local_receivers.configuration: Fixed Shared test entry point selected before proof reads; cleared environment, four Rayon threads, cwd contains only the sample proof and expected 57-word statement; stdin carries statement followed by proof; no program, input, output, child proof or prover state supplied.

full_workload_estimates.limitations: Count floor uses one instruction fetch per profiled Eval transition. Size projection uses the observed 498939-byte leaf size. Time projection assumes the short-window throughput persists; it excludes native replay, source admission, output, commitments and recursive aggregation, and is not a measured full-run duration.
